workouts.title: Easy Swim
workouts.description: Start the week with an easy swim to build water confidence and practice your breathing technique.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take today completely off to let your body recover and adapt to the training.

workouts.title: Easy Spin
workouts.description: Keep the bike ride easy and comfortable to build your aerobic base without fatigue.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to keep your energy high for the upcoming running session.

workouts.title: Easy Run/Walk
workouts.description: Alternate running and walking to ease your joints into the impact of running.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy a rest day and focus on drinking plenty of water today.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Finish the first week with a relaxing rest day to prepare for week two.

workouts.title: Technique Swim
workouts.description: Focus on smooth strokes and good body position in the water during this gentle swim.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest your muscles today and prepare for a steady ride tomorrow.

workouts.title: Steady Bike
workouts.description: Pedal at a moderate pace to improve your leg endurance and cardiovascular fitness.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a rest day to help your legs recover from the bike ride.

workouts.title: Continuous Run
workouts.description: Run at a steady, conversational pace for as much of the duration as you comfortably can.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Relax today and let your body absorb the running and biking miles.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest up so you start week three feeling fresh and motivated.

workouts.title: Endurance Swim
workouts.description: Swim at a comfortable, steady pace to build longer distance capability in the pool.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to keep your energy levels balanced.

workouts.title: Hill Bike
workouts.description: Ride on a slightly hilly route or use resistance to build leg strength on the bike.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take today off to recover your leg muscles from the hilly bike ride.

workouts.title: Interval Run
workouts.description: Alternate fast running with walking recovery to build speed and heart health.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest and stretch lightly today to soothe your running muscles.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and get ready for the final week of this training block.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Start the recovery week with complete rest to let your body heal.

workouts.title: Recovery Swim
workouts.description: Enjoy an easy, relaxed swim focusing purely on feeling good in the water.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take today off to keep recovery on track.

workouts.title: Recovery Bike
workouts.description: Spin the pedals very lightly to flush out any lingering muscle fatigue.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today in preparation for a short recovery run.

workouts.title: Recovery Run
workouts.description: Jog at a very slow, easy pace just to keep your running routine going.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and celebrate completing your first recovery week.

workouts.title: Distance Swim
workouts.description: Swim longer intervals with short rests to build your triathlon swim stamina.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to give your upper body a break after swimming.

workouts.title: Longer Bike
workouts.description: Build endurance with a steady, comfortable ride lasting longer than previous weeks.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a rest day so your legs recover well from the longer ride.

workouts.title: Endurance Run
workouts.description: Maintain a steady conversational pace to build your running aerobic engine.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and hydrate well.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy your Sunday rest day before starting week six.

workouts.title: Interval Swim
workouts.description: Swim short fast laps followed by easy rests to boost your speed in the water.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest your upper body today after your hard swim workout.

workouts.title: Steady Bike
workouts.description: Ride at a strong, steady pace to improve your cycling threshold.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take today off to let your leg muscles recover fully.

workouts.title: Tempo Run
workouts.description: Run at a comfortably hard pace for most of the session to build speed endurance.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Relax and stretch lightly today to soothe tired legs.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and prepare for the introduction of brick workouts next week.

workouts.title: Endurance Swim
workouts.description: Swim at a moderate pace to maintain your strong water fitness.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to save energy for your first ever brick workout.

workouts.title: First Brick Workout
workouts.description: Practice the feeling of running right after cycling by doing a short bike followed immediately by a short run.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a well-earned rest day after combining biking and running.

workouts.title: Steady Run
workouts.description: Run at a steady, comfortable pace to reinforce your running form.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and relax your muscles.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and get ready for the final week of training.

workouts.title: Race Prep Swim
workouts.description: Swim at a strong pace simulating how you will start your sprint triathlon swim.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and let your upper body recover.

workouts.title: Race Simulation Brick
workouts.description: Combine a moderate bike ride with a run to practice your triathlon transition skills.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a rest day to help your legs recover from the brick session.

workouts.title: Final Easy Run
workouts.description: Enjoy a relaxed, easy run to wrap up your final week of training successfully.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and feel proud of your hard work over the last eight weeks.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a final rest day to relax and enjoy the feeling of accomplishment.
